# Project and base generation

Name the ROM hack or mod and the canonical generation it extends.

# Requested scope

Describe whether this needs a selectable profile, calculation overlay, trainer pack, save import adapter, exclusive profile tool, or a combination of them.

# Authors and permission

List the data authors, maintainers, public source, version, and license or explicit redistribution permission. Do not submit another person's data without permission.

# Data differences

Summarize the species, forms, stats, types, moves, abilities, items, trainers, rules, or save layout that differ from the canonical generation.

# Submission files

For a complete profile proposal, follow the [mod submission guide](https://github.com/KotMatrosk1n/KM-Companion/blob/master/docs/mod-submissions.md). Copy its starter folder, fill the project manifest and eight category files, and attach a ZIP or public repository link. State the exact mod version and any draft gaps. If you used the optional author checker, include its summary. Passing the format check does not establish runtime support.

For a trainer import only, use the existing trainer pack JSON format instead. Keep the two formats distinct.

# Public references

Link the official project page and any public technical documentation that reviewers may use to verify the proposal.

# Maintenance plan

Explain who can confirm future updates and how the profile or pack version will be tracked.

# File safety

Do not attach ROMs, patches containing copyrighted game data, game dumps, console keys, executable game files, private saves, credentials, signing material, personal data, complete generated mods, or private research. Small original examples and synthetic data that follows the schema are welcome.
